title: Game rules
description: The game-wide tunables in content/rules/core.json. Systems read tunables from here and never from constants. The file has no id.

cartTicksPerTile.description: Ticks a cart takes to cross one tile of road cost 1000.

outputBuffer.description: The most a producer's output buffer holds, per good.

cartLoad.description: The amount one cart carries; must not exceed outputBuffer.

declineGraceDays.description: Days a basic need may stay unmet before a house steps down a tier.

advanceStreakDays.description: Consecutive days all basic needs must be met before a house advances.

inspirationDiscountPerMille.description: The share of a node's full cost an inspiration removes, in per-mille.

marketGating.description: Whether a house can draw goods only inside a market's coverage.

seasons.description: Productivity multipliers per season, in per-mille, for buildings that carry the tag named by the key.
